characters.name: Snehvit og Rosenrød
characters.description: Den stille, snille prinsessen som vandrer ut i verden for å gjøre godt igjen og redde sine tolv brødre ved å arbeide tålmodig og modig.
characters.look: A slim girl of about seventeen with snow-pale skin, rosy-red cheeks and lips, a soft oval face, a small straight nose and large, dark-grey eyes with long black lashes. Her raven-black hair hangs in one thick, loose braid over her shoulder, tied with a white ribbon. characters.name: Snehvit og Rosenrød som dronning
characters.description: Prinsessen etter at hun har giftet seg med den unge kongen. Om kveldene syr hun skjorter av myrull, og hun kan ikke si et ord, selv når stemoren lyver om henne.
characters.look: A slim young woman of about eighteen with snow-pale skin, rosy-red cheeks and lips, a soft oval face, a small straight nose and large, dark-grey eyes with long black lashes. Her raven-black hair hangs in one thick, loose braid over her shoulder, under a slender silver crown. She wears a long, simple gown of snow-white linen embroidered with small rose-red roses along the hem and cuffs, a rose-red sash and soft grey slippers.

characters.name: Dronningen
characters.description: Moren til de tolv prinsene og prinsessen. Hun ønsket seg en datter så hvit som snø og så rød som blod, og så mistet hun de tolv guttene sine.
characters.look: A warm, motherly queen of about forty with a round face, a soft double chin, a small snub nose, kind hazel eyes, rosy cheeks and wavy chestnut hair going grey at the temples, pinned up under a small gold crown. She wears a long plum-purple winter cloak lined and trimmed with thick white fur over a plum gown, white fur mittens and fur-lined boots.

characters.name: Trollkjerringen
characters.description: En gammel trollkjerring med nese som en potet og hår som et kråkereir, som gjør de tolv prinsene om til villender.
characters.look: A short, stout old troll woman, no taller than a fence, with lumpy, sandy-beige skin, a huge knobbly nose exactly like a big potato, small beady black eyes, a wide crooked grin with three teeth, and an enormous tangle of black-and-grey hair like a crow's nest, stuck with twigs and one black feather. A thin cow's tail with a tuft pokes out under her patched grey skirt, and she wears a ragged moss-green shawl and big grey felt boots.

characters.name: Den unge kongen
characters.description: En godhjertet konge som møter prinsessen på myra, tar vare på henne og søker sannheten når det oppstår mistanke.
characters.look: A tall, slim young king of about twenty-five, clean-shaven, with a long, friendly face, a straight nose, warm brown eyes, a wide smile and fair, straight hair tied back at the neck with a dark-blue ribbon. On his head sits a thin gold circlet. He wears a sky-blue wool coat trimmed with white braid and fastened with brass toggles, a broad brown leather belt, fawn trousers, soft grey suede boots and a short grey travelling cloak.

characters.name: Den gamle stemoren
characters.description: En misunnelig, lur kvinne ved slottet som skaper uro med løgner, men til slutt blir sendt bort så hun ikke kan skade noen.
characters.look: A bony, very upright old woman with a long, pointed chin, a small hooked nose, narrow darting eyes, thin lips, a heavily powdered white face with two round spots of pink rouge, and a tall tower of steel-grey hair stuck with jewelled pins. She wears a stiff black brocade gown shot with silver thread and a tall, fan-shaped collar of grey lace, rings on every finger, and a silver hand mirror on a chain at her waist.

characters.name: Den yngste broren
characters.description: Den yngste av de tolv brødrene som er villender om dagen og prinser om natten. Han er snill mot søsteren sin fra første stund.
characters.look: A slim young man of about sixteen, the smallest of twelve brothers, with snow-pale skin, a narrow, gentle face, a small straight nose, large dark-grey eyes and tousled raven-black hair that sticks up at the back like ruffled feathers. He wears a faded bottle-green cap, a worn chestnut-brown wool tunic with a white collar and a rope belt, patched grey trousers and soft grey boots.

characters.name: Den yngste broren med vingen
characters.description: Den yngste broren når trolldommen er brutt. Den siste skjorten fikk bare ett erme, så han har en andevinge i stedet for venstre arm.
characters.look: A slim young man of about sixteen with snow-pale skin, a narrow, gentle face, a small straight nose, large dark-grey eyes and tousled raven-black hair that sticks up at the back like ruffled feathers. He wears a new, soft snow-white shirt, cap and scarf woven from bog cotton, grey trousers and soft grey boots. In place of his left arm he has a large wild duck's wing of grey-brown feathers with a shiny blue-violet patch edged in white.

places.name: the Brothers' Cabin
places.look: The inside of a small, cosy log cabin deep in a spruce forest: walls of round honey-brown logs, twelve narrow box beds built into the walls in two tiers of six, twelve wooden pegs by the door, a long plank table with twelve chairs, a squat black iron stove with a woodbox beside it, a braided rag rug on the plank floor and one small window looking out on tall spruces.

places.name: the Castle Courtyard
places.look: A wide cobbled courtyard in front of the young king's castle, a long, dark-red painted timber castle with white window frames, a tall gate tower with a shingled spire and a broad wooden stair up to the main door. A round stone well stands in the middle, and a wide archway in the far wall opens onto a bumpy road leading into the spruce forest.
